name: SHTC3 temperature & humidity sensor
description: Sensirion SHTC3 digital temperature (-40 to 125 °C, ±0.2 °C typical) and relative humidity (0–100 %, ±2 % typical) sensor with an I2C interface at fixed address 0x70. The chip runs on 1.62–3.6 V; the breakout adds a 3.3 V regulator, level shifting and 10 kΩ I2C pull-ups. Sold as: Adafruit Sensirion SHTC3 Temperature & Humidity Sensor - STEMMA QT / Qwiic (#4636; 5-pin header VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, plus two STEMMA QT sockets).
eli5: Tells your board how warm the air is and how damp it is.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply, 3–5 V (on-board 3.3 V regulator; use the same voltage as your board's logic)

pins.name: 3Vo
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator (up to 100 mA); not a supply input, leave unconnected

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (10 kΩ pull-up and level shifter on the board)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (10 kΩ pull-up and level shifter on the board)

supplierQuery: Adafruit SHTC3 temperature humidity sensor STEMMA QT 4636
buildNotes: The SHTC3 should sleep between readings: send wake-up 0x35 0x17 (wait 240 µs), then measure, then sleep 0xB0 0x98. In sleep mode it ignores every command except wake-up.
Measure (normal mode, temperature first, no clock stretching) with 0x78 0x66, wait at least 12.1 ms, then read 6 bytes: temperature MSB, LSB, CRC, humidity MSB, LSB, CRC.
Check each CRC (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). A mismatch almost always means a loose SDA/SCL wire.
Conversion uses 2^16: T = -45 + 175 × raw / 65536 °C, RH = 100 × raw / 65536 %.
The address is fixed at 0x70, so only one SHTC3 per I2C bus.
Leave 3Vo unconnected; it is the regulator's output, not a supply input.
Keep the sensor away from the board's regulator and the ESP32, which warm the air around them.

driver.code:
# SHTC3 temperature & humidity sensor (Sensirion SHTC3), MicroPython driver.
# Each reading follows the datasheet's measurement cycle: wake-up (0x3517), measure in normal
# mode, temperature first, no clock stretching (0x7866), read 6 bytes, sleep (0xB098).
# CRC-8 checked as in the datasheet (poly 0x31, init 0xFF).
# Conversion: T = -45 + 175 * S / 2^16 degC, RH = 100 * S / 2^16 %.
import time

_WAKEUP = b'\x35\x17'
_SLEEP = b'\xb0\x98'
_MEASURE_T_FIRST = b'\x78\x66'
_SOFT_RESET = b'\x80\x5d'
_READ_ID = b'\xef\xc8'


def _crc8(data):
    crc = 0xFF
    for b in data:
        crc ^= b
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x31) & 0xFF if crc & 0x80 else (crc << 1) & 0xFF
    return crc


class SHTC3:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x70):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        time.sleep_ms(1)  # power-up time, max 240 us
        ident = self.id()
        if ident & 0x083F != 0x0807:
            raise OSError('no SHTC3 found (ID 0x%04X)' % ident)

    def _wake(self):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, _WAKEUP)
        time.sleep_us(300)  # wake-up time, max 240 us

    def _sleep(self):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, _SLEEP)

    def id(self):
        """Read the 16-bit ID register (SHTC3: bits 11 and 5..0 read 1 000111)."""
        self._wake()
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, _READ_ID)
        d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 3)
        self._sleep()
        if _crc8(d[0:2]) != d[2]:
            raise OSError('SHTC3 CRC mismatch: check the wiring')
        return (d[0] << 8) | d[1]

    def reset(self):
        """Soft reset (0x805D); the sensor is idle again after at most 240 us."""
        self._wake()
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, _SOFT_RESET)
        time.sleep_us(300)
        self._sleep()

    def read(self):
        """Measure once and return (temperature in degC, relative humidity in %)."""
        self._wake()
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, _MEASURE_T_FIRST)
        time.sleep_ms(13)  # normal mode takes up to 12.1 ms
        d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 6)
        self._sleep()
        if _crc8(d[0:2]) != d[2] or _crc8(d[3:5]) != d[5]:
            raise OSError('SHTC3 CRC mismatch: check the wiring')
        t_raw = (d[0] << 8) | d[1]
        rh_raw = (d[3] << 8) | d[4]
        return -45 + 175 * t_raw / 65536, 100 * rh_raw / 65536

    def temperature(self):
        return self.read()[0]

    def humidity(self):
        return self.read()[1]

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from shtc3 import SHTC3

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = SHTC3(i2c)
while True:
    t, h = sensor.read()
    print('T=%.1fC H=%.0f%%' % (t, h))
    time.sleep(1)
